s.note: Grimm's disguise for the bank job
s.how: Cut the tops off 24 cherry tomatoes and scoop out the seeds. Blitz 150g feta with a handful of basil, the zest of 1 lemon and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Pipe into the tomatoes and top each with a small basil leaf. A red nose for every guest.

s.note: so close to getting out of the city
s.how: Pat 1kg chicken wings dry, toss with 1 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Roast on a rack at 220C for 40 to 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp and cooked through. Melt 30g butter with 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp sweet chilli sauce, 1 tsp chilli flakes and the zest and juice of 2 limes. Toss the wings through and scatter with coriander.

m.note: for a city that won't let you leave
m.how: Split 4 kaiser rolls, spread with 80g mayonnaise and 1 tbsp mustard. Fill with 400g sliced turkey, 8 slices Swiss cheese, shredded iceberg lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes, and season with salt and pepper. Wrap each tightly in paper and cut in half.

w.how: Split a 400g sponge cake and fill with 100g raspberry jam. Beat 200g butter with 400g icing sugar and spread all over the cake. Tint a little leftover buttercream and pipe a clown face on top, then press a maraschino cherry in for the nose.

d.note: a toast to finally leaving New York
d.how: In a shaker, muddle 12 mint leaves and 4 lemon wedges with 40ml sugar syrup. Add 180ml bourbon and ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Double strain into 4 glasses filled with crushed ice. Top with a fat sprig of mint and serve with short straws.
